title: The Lone Goblin
objective: Drive out the goblin that has taken over the inn's cellar.

rooms.name: Inn Cellar
rooms.description: A low stone cellar lit by one guttering lantern. Broken casks line the walls, and the floor is wet with spilled ale.

opponents.description: A small, sharp-toothed goblin in scraps of leather, scimitar already drawn.

endings.title: The cellar is clear
endings.text: The goblin falls among the broken casks. The cellar is quiet again, and the innkeeper can sleep tonight.

endings.title: Fallen in the cellar
endings.text: You fall to the wet stone floor. Your adventuring ends here.
